'''House Janevor''' is one of the known minor [[Nobility|noble]] [[House]]s of [[Andor]].

The only known member of the House is Lord [[Kelwin Janevor]]. He is quick to lend his support to [[Elayne Trakand]] during the [[Succession Wars#Fourth Succession War|Fourth Succession War]], and brings his armsmen to [[Caemlyn]].
